name: markora
description: A headless, embeddable Markdown editor toolkit built with ProseMirror and CodeMirror.
author: Kevin Wang

scripts.build: node ./scripts/cleanDist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ./scripts/copyStyles.mjs && node ../../scripts/fix-node-esm-specifiers.mjs dist
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:api && pnpm run smoke:node-esm
scripts.smoke:node-esm: node --input-type=module -e "const [root, minimal, extensionApi, themes] = await Promise.all([import('./dist/index.js'), import('./dist/minimal.js'), import('./dist/extension-api.js'), import('./dist/themes.js')]); if (typeof themes.defineTheme !== 'function' || typeof themes.createThemeController !== 'function' || themes.builtInThemes.length !== 8) throw new Error('theme API export missing'); if (typeof root.createEditor !== 'function') throw new Error('createEditor export missing'); if (typeof minimal.createEditor !== 'function') throw new Error('minimal createEditor export missing'); if (typeof extensionApi.defineMarkdownEditorExtension !== 'function') throw new Error('extension API export missing'); if (typeof extensionApi.closeHistory !== 'function') throw new Error('closeHistory export missing'); if (typeof extensionApi.readMarkdownEditorOpaqueTokenSource !== 'function') throw new Error('opaque token source export missing');"
